translation.translation_note: Translated 'co-hosted' as 'aliyekuwa mwenyeji mwenza wa' (was co-host of) for natural phrasing in Swahili.

backtranslation_en.question: Which male television presenter co-hosted the first night of the Sanremo Music Festival 2025?
